The '''''Tellivar Lady''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fane]] that made regular runs to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> The ''Tellivar Lady'' landed at [[Docking Bay 9 (Tatooine)|Docking Bay 9]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on Tatooine<ref name="Nightlily">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> While looking for a way offworld, the [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]] [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]] met [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]], a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Tax collector/Legends|tax collector]], in Mos Eisley who told her that he would talk to Captain Fane about having her travel on the ''Tellivar Lady''. However Trevagg&mdash;who was hoping to keep Onith on Tatooine for the night&mdash;took his time getting to Docking Bay 9 and by the time he arrived the ship had departed.<ref name="Nightlily" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Tellivar Lady'' was first mentioned in the short story "[[Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale]]" written by [[Barbara Hambly]] and published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in the [[1995]] anthology ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''.
